name: wilbur's limbo
source:
After dying by the hands of his own father; Wilbur Soot is in limbo.
He's been here for years. All alone. 
Every day is the same.
How could today be any different?

[From [url=https://yinadev.itch.io/hislimbo]Itch.io[/url]]
